---
title: "About"
---

**AI Field Guide** is an open programme for learning about AI. It's organised as independent **modules**, and each one is its own project with its own site and repository, so you can take one without the others.

## Principles

- **Primary sources first:** laws, official strategies, papers and lab documents, so you can check claims yourself.
- **Every link backed up:** each reading links to its source and to an archived copy.
- **Standalone modules:** start anywhere.
- **Open:** all content is on [GitHub](https://github.com/AI-Field-Guide). Corrections and suggestions are welcome as issues or pull requests.

| AI in Society | Planned | |

## Adding a module

Each module is a separate Quarto website repository in the organisation. Copy the structure of `ai-governance`, then add a card on the [home page](https://github.com/AI-Field-Guide/AI-Field-Guide.github.io/blob/main/index.qmd).
